1–2 hours of play + 24 h wait (outfit) + 5 days wait (beard)

The stylist {npc:Hugo}, in Venore, had a vision of a new look: the 'beggar look'. Bring him the materials and he makes you the {wiki:Beggar Outfits|Beggar Outfit}. Then {npc:Simon the Beggar}, south of Fibula, sells you the beard (or the gypsy dress, if you are female) and swaps his staff for the favourite staff he lost in Edron's Hero Cave.
Hugo is working on the design of this look. He may need some inspiration, so if you have time, feel free to give him some ideas.
No minimum level (70+ recommended for Edron's Hero Cave, for the staff addon).
The staff addon can only be done after the beard/dress addon.
outfit; drops from Elves and Elf Scouts
outfit; drops from Ghouls and Barbarians
outfit; drops from Bats and Mutated Bats
staff addon; Simon's favourite staff, in Edron's Hero Cave
to climb up the Hero Cave holes on your way out
in a bag, in the chest of the final staff room
Gather all the materials **before** talking to Hugo and Simon: you save trips.

{item:Brown Piece of Cloth|Brown Pieces of Cloth} drop from {creature:Ghoul|Ghouls} and Barbarians; {item:Minotaur Leather|Minotaur Leathers} from {creature:Minotaur|Minotaurs}; {item:Bat Wing|Bat Wings} from {creature:Bat|Bats} or {creature:Mutated Bat|Mutated Bats}; {item:Heaven Blossom|Heaven Blossoms} from {creature:Elf|Elves} and {creature:Elf Scout|Elf Scouts}; {item:Ape Fur|Ape Furs} from Apes.

Go to Venore and talk to {npc:Hugo} (southeast of the depot, 1 floor up): {key:hi}, {key:outfit}, {key:yes}, {key:yes}. He needs 20 Brown Pieces of Cloth, 50 Minotaur Leathers, 10 Bat Wings and 30 Heaven Blossoms.

With everything in your inventory, hand over one material at a time: say {key:20 brown pieces of cloth} and {key:yes}, {key:50 minotaur leathers} and {key:yes}, {key:10 bat wings} and {key:yes}, {key:30 heaven blossoms} and {key:yes}.
Wait **24 real hours** and go back to {npc:Hugo}: {key:hi}, {key:outfit}, {key:yes}.
You need 100 {item:Ape Fur|Ape Furs} and 20,000 gp.

Fibula is a small island **southwest** of Thais. From Thais, cross the {wiki:Fibula Tunnel|Fibula Tunnel}: the mainland-side entrance is at the marked spot; follow the tunnel (there are only {creature:Cave Rat|Cave Rats}) until you come out in Fibula. Simon is on the **south** coast of the island. To come back, go through the tunnel in reverse to Thais.

Go to the south of Fibula and talk to {npc:Simon the Beggar}: {key:hi}, {key:outfit} (or {key:beard}), {key:yes}, {key:yes}. He makes an *Instabeard* potion for 100 Ape Furs and 20,000 gp. If you play a female character, instead of the beard he offers you a gypsy dress and a pearl necklace for the same price.
Simon the Beggar, south of Fibula
With 100 {item:Ape Fur|Ape Furs} and 20,000 gp, say {key:ape fur} and {key:yes}.
If you're a female character, you get the dress right away: say {key:hi} and {key:gypsy dress}.
Female Beggar with the gypsy dress
If you're a male character, talk to Simon again: {key:hi} and {key:beard} (or {key:addon}). He sprinkles you with the potion and tells you to wait.
Wait **at least 120 real hours (5 days)**. Then come back and say {key:hi} and {key:addon}. If he says it's not ready yet, say {key:beard} to remind him and wait longer.
It can take more than 5 days: sometimes Simon *forgets* your addon (it's random) and you have to remind him.
You can only do this addon after you have the beard/dress one.
Talk to {npc:Simon the Beggar}: {key:hi}, {key:addon} (or {key:beard}), then {key:staff}, {key:yes}, {key:yes}. He lost his favourite staff in the ruins in the north of Edron.

Go to **Edron** by boat (at the captain in your city's port say {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}) and, from the port, head **north** to the entrance of the {wiki:Hero Cave|Hero Cave}, north of the city. Follow the path to the main hunting level, where you reach the Demons. Use the images as a guide.

Along the way you'll meet, in order: {creature:Hunter|Hunters}, {creature:Wild Warrior|Wild Warriors}, {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons}, {creature:Dark Magician|Dark Magicians}, {creature:Dark Apprentice|Dark Apprentices}, {creature:Priestess|Priestesses}, {creature:Bonelord|Bonelords}, {creature:Monk (Creature)|Monks}, {creature:Dragon|Dragons}, {creature:Dragon Hatchling|Dragon Hatchlings}, {creature:Hero|Heroes}, {creature:Stalker|Stalkers}, {creature:Minotaur Mage|Minotaur Mages} and {creature:Stone Golem|Stone Golems}.
On that level, walk a little **south** from the hole and enter the **right-hand** room (the left-hand room is the {wiki:Triple UH Rune Quest|Triple UH Rune Quest} one).
The entrance to Simon's staff rooms

Go down the stairs **two floors** to the final room and pick up {item:Staff (Simon)|Simon's favourite staff}. In these rooms there are {creature:Monk (Creature)|Monks}, {creature:Stone Golem|Stone Golems} and {creature:Priestess|Priestesses}.
The final room with Simon's staff
In the final room there is also a chest with a bag containing 5 {item:Strong Mana Potion|Strong Mana Potions}.

Go back the **same way**: climb the two floors of the staff rooms, return to the hole you used to reach the main level and retrace the images in reverse, using the {item:Rope} on the holes and climbing the stairs you came by, up to the Hero Cave entrance. Outside, head **south** to Edron and take {npc:Captain Seahorse}'s boat to **Thais** ({key:hi}, {key:thais}, {key:yes}); from there go through the Fibula Tunnel to Simon.
Go back to {npc:Simon the Beggar}: {key:hi}, {key:staff}, {key:yes}. He gives you the current staff as an addon.
Hugo's 24 h wait and Simon's 5 days are in real time, not Tibia time.
